name: aqar
description: Find properties to rent or buy in Saudi Arabia using Aqar listing search, property details and district lookup.

interface.longDescription:
Aqar is a real-estate search plugin for people looking to rent or buy property in Saudi Arabia. Users anywhere can search in Arabic or English by city, district, property type, price, area, bedrooms and furnishing. Browse public listings in photo cards, read individual property details, and look up Saudi districts. Supported properties include apartments, villas, floors, land, offices, stores, warehouses, rest houses and chalets.

Prices are in Saudi riyals (SAR); rental prices are per rental period, usually yearly. Every listing links to sa.aqar.fm. No Aqar account or precise user location is required. The plugin searches and reads listings; contacting advertisers, arranging viewings, booking and payment take place outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: شقة للإيجار في حي النرجس بالرياض
Find a 3-bedroom rental in north Riyadh under SAR 80,000/year

positive.prompt: شقة للإيجار في حي النرجس بالرياض
positive.expected_behavior: Search apartment_for_rent in الرياض with district النرجس; show matching listing cards and links, or accurately report no matches.

positive.prompt: Find a 3-bedroom apartment for rent in north Riyadh under 80,000 SAR a year.
positive.expected_behavior: Use city Riyadh, district شمال الرياض, category apartment_for_rent, min_bedrooms 3, max_price 80000 and rent_period yearly. Describe the bedroom filter as 3 or more; preserve reported price periods.
List districts for جدة using returned Arabic district names.

positive.prompt: Find an apartment for sale in Riyadh, then show full details of the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Search apartment_for_sale in الرياض, then pass the first returned id or URL to get_listing. Report only returned details and link to the listing. If no results, report that and do not invent an id.

positive.prompt: ابحث عن فلل للبيع في الرياض واعرض الصفحة الثانية
positive.expected_behavior: Search villa_for_sale in الرياض with page 2, preserving filters and presenting returned cards and listing links.

negative.prompt: Find an apartment for rent in Dubai.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Aqar covers Saudi Arabia; do not call Aqar tools for Dubai or silently substitute a Saudi city.

negative.prompt: اتصل بالمعلن واحجز العقار وادفع العربون
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that contact, booking and payment are unavailable; provide an existing listing link if known, without claiming to take action.
Ask for the city before searching; do not guess a location or request precise GPS coordinates.

review.commerce_description: The plugin only searches and reads public property listings. It cannot contact advertisers, book properties or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: search apartments, villas, land and more for rent or sale across Saudi Arabia, in Arabic or English, and open full listing details on Aqar.

ar-SA.subtitle: ابحث عن عقارك في السعودية
ar-SA.description: ابحث عن عقارات للإيجار أو البيع في السعودية عبر عقار، بالعربية أو الإنجليزية. تصفح بطاقات الإعلانات بالصور والأسعار وعدد غرف النوم والمساحة والحي، أو اعرض تفاصيل إعلان محدد. البحث متاح دون تسجيل دخول أو طلب موقعك الدقيق. أسعار الإيجار حسب فترة الإيجار، وغالباً سنوية. للتواصل مع المعلن، افتح رابط الإعلان على موقع عقار. لا يدعم هذا المكون التواصل أو الحجز أو الدفع.
